items.t: Loose timing-case dowel pin ("killer dowel pin")
items.job: Install killer dowel pin retaining tab kit
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the pin already fell into the gear case and damaged parts.

items.t: 47RE automatic slipping or losing overdrive
items.job: Replace with a remanufactured 47RE transmission
items.note: Reman price assumes you return the old unit as a core. Minor fixes like band adjustment cost far less.

items.t: VP44 injection pump failure (weak lift pump)
items.job: Replace VP44 injection pump and lift pump
items.note: Reman pump prices assume a core return. Fixing the weak lift pump helps the new pump last.

items.t: 48RE automatic slipping, shudder or overdrive failure
items.job: Replace with a remanufactured 48RE transmission
items.note: Converter-only or valve body repairs cost less. Price assumes a core return.

items.t: Common-rail fuel injector wear
items.job: Replace all six fuel injectors
items.note: Includes new injector tubes. Replacing only the failed injectors costs less.

items.t: EGR cooler leaking coolant into the engine
items.job: Replace EGR cooler
items.note: Cost rises a lot if coolant in the cylinders damaged the engine.

items.t: Variable-geometry turbo sticking
items.job: Replace turbocharger
items.note: Cleaning the vanes or replacing just the actuator costs much less if that fixes it.

items.t: DEF / SCR system faults and NOx sensor failures
items.job: Replace NOx sensor
items.note: Price is per sensor. A DEF heater or doser repair costs more.

items.t: Drag link nut can loosen (recall 19V-021)
items.job: Inspect and secure drag link nut; replace drag link if needed
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Hemi lifter and camshaft wear
items.job: Replace camshaft and lifters
items.note: Cost rises a lot if metal debris damaged the rest of the engine.

items.t: CP4 high-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace CP4 pump, injectors and lines; clean fuel system
items.note: If caught before debris spread, a pump alone costs much less.

items.t: Side curtain airbag inflator may rupture (recall 25V-824)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbags per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN and book as soon as parts are available.

items.t: Transmission fluid can spray from the dipstick tube (recall 22V-835)
items.job: Replace transmission dipstick and vent assembly per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Intake air heater relay can short and start a fire (recalls 21V-163, 21V-798)
items.job: Inspect and replace intake heater grid relay
items.note: Free under the recalls. Check your VIN right away.

items.t: Software may let speed exceed the tire rating (recall 26V-288)
items.job: Engine computer software update per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Rearview camera may not display (recall 26V-327)
items.job: Update or replace camera processing module per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Most trucks need only a software update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Instrument cluster display can go blank (recalls 25V-826, 26V-225)
items.job: Update cluster software or replace cluster per recall
items.note: Free under the recalls. Most trucks need only a software update. Check your VIN.

items.t: Trailer lights and trailer brakes may fail (recall 26V-059)
items.job: Replace trailer tow module per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Airbag and stability control software error (recall 25V-882)
items.job: Airbag controller software update per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Steering column module may disable stability control (recalls 26V-244, 26V-651)
items.job: Replace steering column control module per recall
items.note: Free under the recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Dashboard top cracks and crumbles
items.job: Fit a moulded dash top cover or replace the dash pad
items.note: A bolt-on cover is the cheap fix; a full dash pad swap is most of the labor.
